This is the all-new Toyota RAV4! 

Mat’s got his hands on this all-new, family-friendly SUV to see if it has what it takes to compete with class leaders like the Volkswagen Tiguan and Jaecoo 8. The RAV4 rolls up with a hefty price rise since the previous iteration, but is it worth it? Let’s take a closer look, starting with the design… 

There’s no denying that the RAV4 looks pretty smart on the outside. We’ve got our hands on the mid-level iteration, and your attention is immediately drawn to the angular headlights and bonnet with creases that mimic the Land Cruiser. If you pick the GR version, you have a sportier front bumper than what we have here, but we think it looks more than good enough without upgrading.
